iPad, iPhone

Critical risks don’t wait until teams are back at a desk.

Forwood One puts critical risk management into the hands of supervisors, safety leaders and frontline teams, so life-saving controls can be verified where real work happens.

Built for high-risk operations across mining, energy, construction, utilities and heavy industry, the Forwood One mobile app makes verifications, inspections and actions faster to complete and easier to act on. Online or offline.

Glide through structured forms and checklists. Capture evidence. Create actions. And sync completed work back to the Forwood One platform when connected.

For safety leaders
Get stronger visibility into whether critical controls are being checked in real work.

For supervisors
Have a clearer way to guide frontline teams, manage follow-up and keep leaders informed.

For frontline teams
Get simple, guided workflows to complete the right activity at the right time.



With Forwood One you can:

Verify critical controls where risk is present

Complete verifications and inspections at the point of work, so leaders can see whether life-saving controls are holding.

Turn field activity into visible risk insight

Capture verifications, inspections, evidence and actions in one connected workflow that syncs back to the Forwood One platform.

• Work confidently online or offline

Continue core safety workflows in remote, underground and low-connectivity environments.

Capture what matters in the moment

Add comments, evidence and supporting information while completing inspections and verifications.

Close the loop on follow-up work

Create, view, update and complete actions, so follow-up work does not disappear into a blind spot.

Stay clear on sync status

See what has synced, what is pending and what needs attention when connectivity changes.

Resume work without losing progress

Return to in-progress forms after switching apps or stepping away from the device.

Access support inside the app

Reach Forwood support channels directly from Forwood One.


Fatality prevention depends on what happens before an incident.

Forwood One gives teams a clearer way to verify controls, capture evidence and close actions in the field.

So leaders can see what needs attention earlier, and act before risk becomes harm.

Download Forwood One and start strengthening your fatality prevention today.

What’s New
Introducing Forwood One for iOS. Complete field verifications, inspections and actions, capture evidence, work online or offline, and sync completed work back to the Forwood One platform.
